LanguageData.Raven_Building_SunRaiserInjector.label: [Raven] Sun Raiser
LanguageData.Raven_Building_SunRaiserInjector.descrip: The ultimate industrial and research center of Raven Fusang craftsmanship. It takes in items from conveyors and liquids from the Raven pipe network, providing unlimited storage in its central warehouse. These resources are used directly for Raven research and upgrading the nexus.\n\nThe core constantly generates massive energy and a mood-boosting glow. You can also use the control panel to spend extra power to illuminate the entire map.
